displayIdentity.body: A dispute about greatness arises; Jesus contrasts Gentile rulers with the greatest becoming like the younger and the leader like one who serves, then speaks of kingdom, table, and thrones.
displayIdentity.title: A dispute over greatness is answered by service and table promise
